launch_product_resources.formula: Digit 5 launch BOM + provider deployment + annual software/maintenance cost × assumed life
launch_product_resources.label: Named provider product cost at assumed launch BOM
launch_product_resources.scope: Management product-cost boundary excludes corporate SG&A/R&D; neither complete company cash nor a field-qualified cost estimate.

other_gross_financing_components.formula: reported aggregate gross financing − included prior funding
other_gross_financing_components.label: Gross headline less already-received component
other_gross_financing_components.scope: Arithmetic of approximate headline components before expenses; not net new cash or available cash balance.

ownership_five_year_payments.formula: purchase + deployment fee + annual service × assumed life
ownership_five_year_payments.label: Displayed ownership payment components
ownership_five_year_payments.scope: Same hypothetical life; these payments do not identify an executed customer contract or whole-system cost.

raas_five_year_payments.formula: monthly subscription × 12 × assumed life + deployment fee
raas_five_year_payments.label: Displayed RaaS payment components
raas_five_year_payments.scope: Undiscounted arithmetic of rounded planning amounts; excludes customer retained work, financing and all other unpriced costs.

financial_periods.scope: Whole-company amounts for unequal observation periods; no annualization or per-robot allocation.
Whole-company amounts for unequal observation periods; no annualization or per-robot allocation.

commercial_disclosures.population_guard: No ratio combines site totes and multi-program fleet hours.
commercial_disclosures.rounding_boundary: Exact component arithmetic can differ from approximate slide headlines; this is not a correction of undisclosed internal modeling.
commercial_disclosures.source_boundary: Source assumptions and historical disclosures remain separate from synthetic model parameters.

customer_payback.reason: No dated investment and avoidable cash flow.

customer_roi.reason: No executed price and complete matched cash schedule.

net_new_closing_cash.reason: Rounded gross aggregate includes prior funding and excludes expenses; post-close reconciliation absent.

paid_labor_removed.reason: No matched schedules or payroll change.

provider_runway.reason: Post-close unrestricted cash and future spending schedule are not established.

site_accepted_output_rate.reason: No matched site time and accepted/on-time count.

field_support.conflict_disposition: Retain both; do not select a calibrated success probability.
field_support.paid_labor_saving_missing_reason: Phase means do not identify complete paid support or removable staffing.

onboard_timing.missing_reason: Rounded component-sum summary statistics do not identify a full cycle, sustained operation or deadline-miss distribution.

tac_costs.full_business_cost_missing_reason: Separate environment models, infrastructure, omitted attempts and human work are not fully priced.
tac_costs.rounding_assumption: Each displayed row rounded independently to nearest cent.
